Camila — thanks for the materials. Quick notes from our side after reviewing with Priya:

- The April spike was real (new campaign), and we expect similar bursts over the next 6 months as the product rolls out.
- Procurement prefers shorter-term price holds (3–6 months) rather than long multi-year discounts unless we see guaranteed commit growth.
- Our asks: a price hold for at least 6 months on the current baseline, a flexible burst pool we can draw from across quarters, and a mid-single-digit permanent uplift to committed units (we're comfortable increasing commit ~25–30% if pricing is favorable).

We also need SOC 2 and a high-level SSO/audit trail doc for our security team before we can sign. I'll loop in Legal if the term sheet looks good.

Can you share a variant with a 6-month price hold and a burst-pool option?

Thanks,
Morgan

Camila / team — quick take and two paths we can offer Nexera: 

Option A — 12-month commit (preferred):
- 30% increase to committed units (vs current)
- 8% standard discount on list for the 12-month term
- One-time burst credit pool: $75,000 usable over 6 months (applies to overage tokens)
- 3-month price hold on the baseline rate included; extendable to 6 months for a nominal pre-paid buffer (we can structure as an up-front credit draw)

Option B — 24-month commit (for more aggressive discounting):
- 20% increase to committed units (phased ramp over 6 months)
- 12% discount on list for 24 months
- Smaller one-time burst credit: $40,000
- Firm 3-month price hold; 6-month hold requires finance sign-off and a firm commit schedule

Operational asks we should prepare for: SOC 2 cert + SSO audit doc + 30‑day SLA for burst provisioning. Monica, can CS confirm runbook and onboarding timeline if they sign by May 27?
